ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible surface is characterized by a high concentration of low-intensity (dark gray to black) pixels, with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels limited to sparse surface highlights and reflections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, deep V-shaped depression at the center with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a vertical depth reaching approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; the left lobe displays higher pixel-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) compared to the more attenuated serrations on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a concave curvature on the leading edge sweeping toward sharpened distal tips; the trailing edge follows a convex trajectory from the median notch toward the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, roughly circular high-intensity pixel clusters (2-4 pixels in diameter) are visible as isolated points on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Encrusted, irregular high-contrast pixel clusters on the distal tips of both lobes; a prominent semi-circular indentation (missing tissue) is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe between the median notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant morphological asymmetry between the trailing edge serration patterns of the left and right lobes.
